description: Join the Jitsi Meet room 'team-standup-daily' (http://localhost:8080/team-standup-daily). Once inside, open the Keyboard Shortcuts help dialog (press '?' or use the menu). Read the shortcuts, close the dialog, and create a text file at '/home/ga/shortcuts_reference.txt'. In this file, list at least 5 keyboard shortcuts you found, one per line in the format 'KEY - Description' (e.g., 'M - Toggle mute'). Finally, use the appropriate keyboard shortcut to switch the meeting layout to Tile View.
